text:
zara: Kickoff for the relnotes + docs sweep for next release. Scope: migration guide v0.9 -> v1.0, unify streaming SDK snippets, and add a short Known Issues blurb for embed streaming fallback. Need copy + CI fixes by Thursday EOD.

jay: I'm on snippet cleanup. Found JS/Python divergence in streaming calls. Link me the PRs.
zara: Main PRs: #4599 (streaming-snippets) and #4602 (migration-curl). I left a note where python still uses old client.call().
miguel: I'll convert curl examples to /v1/streams and add a jq one-liner for chunked token parsing. Also will double-check the tokens-per-request cost note.

elaine: Ran anchor-check locally. Issues: migration.md references `#deployment-rollout` which was renamed, and streaming.md has an example id mismatch. Command: `./scripts/anchor-check --fail-on=missing` result: missing anchors in migration.md (x2) and snippets/streaming.md example-id mismatch.
docs-bot: CI: docs-linkcheck triggered for #4599. Status: failed (2 anchors).
sam: I'll add frontmatter redirects for the old anchors so existing links keep working. Tiny patch, no content changes.
jay: Proposal: standardize on `client.generate_stream()` across examples; include a brief compatibility note: older SDKs expose `client.stream.*`. Pushed draft to #4610.
miguel: If snippet-tests fail on older runner images, we should flag in the relnotes: "Docs snippets assume SDK >=0.9.1; see compatibility notes." I'll draft that line.
zara: Also drafting Known Issues blurb: "On rare capacity constraints, embed streaming may fall back to a polling mode; tokens can arrive up to ~2s later. The system will attempt to resume streaming automatically." Keep it user-friendly.

elaine: After sam's redirect PR lands, I'll re-run anchor-check and confirm CI.
sam: Redirect frontmatter added in PR #4612. Pushing now.
docs-bot: PR status summary: #4599 (streaming-snippets): failing links; #4610 (snippets-unify): snippet-tests pending; #4612 (redirects): lint OK.
jay: I'll run snippet-tests locally against py runner v0.9.2; if tests break only due to API rename, I'll update tests and note it in the relnotes.
miguel: One more ask: sanity-check the migration guide paragraph on server-side batching changes. I updated cost wording to call out reduced per-token cost in high-throughput setups.
zara: Plan: finish edits by Thursday noon, final copy pass Thursday afternoon, publish Friday midday. Please ping this thread once PRs are green. :sparkles:
